name: @hl-bos/date-sort
description: DateSort engine. Reads a folder of loose camera photos WITHOUT CHANGING ANYTHING in it: identifies each file by its bytes (JPG/JPEG, PNG, HEIC, Canon RAW CR2 and CR3), reads when it was taken (EXIF DateTimeOriginal, then CreateDate, then the file's modified time labelled as an estimate; never EXIF DateTime, which is an edit time), and groups the photos into shooting days. Includes a read-only Canon CR3 metadata reader. No network, no database, no AI.
